scope: MainViewModel.kt draft actor and snapshot CAS
DownloadQueue.kt scheduling and batch receipt protocol
positive_observations: Batch acceptance receipt and stable task identity are committed atomically in waiting-tasks.json; finish/remove retain the receipt until the durable draft no longer contains the identity.
Protocol mutex consistently precedes queue mutex in MainViewModel init/write/handoff paths, and network/retry waits occur outside that mutex.

Draft snapshot token compares complete serialized contents, so concurrent selection/format/destination changes with identical delivery IDs are detected; adoptLatestDraft invalidates buffered older revisions.

take selects FIFO among equal priorities after excluding paused/deferred waiting tasks. Strict cross-priority preference and blocking a paused active lease are explicit behavior, including LibraryQueueTest assertions, so neither was reported as an unsupported fairness defect.

integration_issue.evidence: model.removeBatch(first) references an API no longer present in MainViewModel; source search finds no remaining definition. This is an Android test compile error, independently of runtime behavior.
integration_issue.correct_replacement: Await suspend MainViewModel.queueBatch(entry, DownloadTask(analysis, selectedChoice, destination)) on Main after the entry and its edits are durable. There is no synchronous removal-only replacement: queueBatch performs durable acceptance before removing the row.
required_fixture_changes: withModel currently invokes the entire block before waiting for initial batchSaving=false, so draftReady=false can cause prepareBatch to be ignored. Wait for initial restore before invoking mutations.
Wait for batchSaving=false and batchStorageError=false between prepare/select/destination/choice mutations; those methods now ignore changes while saving.

Provide an analyzed row with a valid Choice in isolated BatchDraft storage, or otherwise finish analysis before submitting; the existing first row obtained directly from prepareBatch has analysis=null.
Make the helper suspend-aware so queueBatch can await its IO-backed actor without blocking Compose Main. BatchHandoffTest ready/close/task fixtures provide the applicable pattern.
Clean up the stable deliveryId queue task after the test because the replacement now commits actual queue work (without starting the service).

validation.method: Read-only source/control-flow review against the current working tree; no production defect with a concrete violating execution was established.
